title: Detection never writes to the repository it looks at, with or without git
assertion: Running detection leaves every file and folder unchanged (names, sizes and modification times): in a committed git repository whose index is out of date, and in a folder that isn't a repository, while it reads workflows, pre-commit, setup.cfg and tox.ini (and the test checks it found them).

origin.text: Phase 1 behaviour, reviewed by Gemini in 3 rounds and strengthened after SeamSpec's reviewer explained two drafts (ADR-20261120-25b5); proposed for the owner to approve.
